disk.eightCachedRecreations: No intended downloads/builds or duplicate immutable image layers, but nonzero writable/log/startup WAL/head/compaction and rollback/capture space; exact peaks unknown
disk.fluentCandidate: Current image47,833,015bytes is a size reference, not an incremental-build bound. New layers/cache/metadata/import and possible missing base transfer require an explicit budget. No build on present host recommended.
disk.oldDockerLogs: Old per-container stdout logs may be removed by Compose replacement. Required protected capture is part of pre-deployment approval; named-volume preservation alone does not preserve them.

stages.name: Pre-deployment stop gates
requirements: Raise/secure physical backing-store reserve or obtain explicit measured no-build capacity-risk acceptance; C is currently below proposed10GiB critical reserve
Approve exact target services, interruption window and required old Docker-log/writable-state capture; source/image hashes must still match this assessment
Review exact candidate native validation evidence; no unsupported config/schema claims; preserve old immutable image refs and compatible secure rollback artifacts
Do not start initializers, migrations, databases, shared JWKS or springboot_project; root Compose only and --no-deps everywhere

stages.name: Independent no-build monitoring/privacy wave
requirements: One service at a time; Prometheus first preserves target/rule visibility before later steps
Tempo before Collector (downstream before upstream); independently verify /ready because running is not readiness
Bounded collector queue/retry window is30s; no-loss requires counted drain/producer quiescence. Approve/measure unavoidable single-instance gaps; do not assume restart finishes within retry window
Collector validation must include successful sanitized ingestion and sampling-aware IDs, not just running state; no Docker healthcheck exists
Grafana last, after Prometheus/Tempo readiness; verify actual authenticated datasource health and cookie/session behavior

stages.name: Collector build/artifact and backlog handoff
requirements: Obtain separately approved P07 collector image build/load under disk budget; existing tag contains old baked config. Retain exact old image refs; no unreviewed tagging or pull/build implicit in up
Standalone pinned Fluent Bit base reference is not present in image store; BuildKit layer reuse possible but offline/no-download build not proven
Quiesce under an approved producer/source continuity window; capture consistent whole state/source boundary, offsets, memory/inflight and item acknowledgements
Retain legacy chunks; decide reviewed quarantine/deferred delivery or reconciled sanitized delivery. No replay, zero-loss claim, discard, offset reset or Read_from_Head override
Account unread JWKS spool records; known populated new path with no established DB rows will start at EOF

Verify candidate schemas, permissions, exact baked hashes and count/ID continuity on approved disposable copies before touching sole live state; future raw collection only after explicit handoff approval

stages.name: Storage-only application/proxy wave
requirements: Prefer after new Fluent Bit sanitized pipeline/handoff is accepted, so startup telemetry uses the reviewed pipeline
Order user-api then vocabulary-api then gateway then frontend; validate each readiness and critical read-only routes before next
Reuse exact inspected cached app manifests, no --build or pulls. Recheck tags immediately before approval/execution
--no-deps prevents SQL Server/MySQL/Flyway/JWKS or dependent service lifecycle; do not rerun initialization jobs
Archive required Docker log history under approved custody first; Compose replacement removes old container and its log/writable layer history even though named volumes survive

stages.name: Final acceptance
requirements: Compare all unrelated original IDs/start times/restarts/mounts/networks and all volume identities; demonstrate only explicitly approved services changed
Validate privacy rejection and native limits without altering existing telemetry; retain historical data separately and do not claim future filters sanitized old records
Close native backend access/TLS/RBAC, durable quotas/reserves/alerts, retention behavior and real recovery/handoff gates; require owner decisions/sign-off
No automatic rollback to raw legacy collector/backlog or weaker privacy controls; preserve evidence and stop acceptance on unaccounted records/errors. P08 remains out of scope

remainingRequirements.backendSecurity: Native store auth/RBAC/TLS, verified collector/Dashboards trust, secret/CA/rotation owners, denial matrix and historical data custody. Nine-service alignment does not implement these.
remainingRequirements.storageQuota: Reviewed durable per-store budget/enforcement and independent host backing reserve. Retention, queue limits, query caps and logging rotation are not hard persistent quotas.
remainingRequirements.diskPressureAlerts: Actual filesystem metric collection, warning/critical/emergency rules, missing-metric detection and tested notification destination. Existing48 rules remain identical and cannot establish disk monitoring.
remainingRequirements.recovery: Consistent protected state/source snapshot, restored counts/IDs/schema and role integrity, acknowledgement/offset ledger, unread/spool/buffer disposition, compatible readers and privacy-safe rollback. Synthetic tmpfs tests do not satisfy durable real-data recovery.
remainingRequirements.retention: Observe actual attachments and effective policies; prove expiry/compaction mechanism on appropriately approved fixtures without purging existing telemetry; include grace/overhead.
remainingRequirements.runtimeRisk: Single-instance downtime, finite memory/retry loss and transient key/cache state must be approved/accounted. No zero-downtime/lossless guarantee.

approval.reason: Planning only. Disk capacity/log custody/rollback and Fluent artifact/handoff gates must be resolved first. Separate approvals: monitoring wave, collector build/load+handoff, application/proxy interruption wave.
